description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Range 30 feet

Every ally you can see gains resistance 5 to physical damage and cannot be reduced below 1 Hit Point by an attack, until the start of your next turn. When this ends, you take 2d6 damage for each ally who was saved from dropping by it — the arithmetic of standing between people and consequences has never balanced any other way.

cinderfall.incomplete: Every ally the caster can see gains resistance 5 to physical damage and can't be reduced below 1 HP until the caster's next turn; when this ends, the caster takes 2d6 damage per ally saved from dropping. No selector prevents a different creature's HP from dropping or grants it resistance from the caster's own passive/action at mass scale, and no companion effect exists to carry a mass ally ward of this shape with real-time damage tracking across many allies simultaneously (same gap as the-convoy-gets-through).
